title: Add a product to your store
blurb: Create a product with photos and price, and show it in your online store.

steps.title: Open Products
steps.body: Go to **Payments** and click **Products**. Your store reads products from here.

steps.title: Add the details
steps.body: Give it a clear title and description, and upload square photos (1024 by 1024 works well).

steps.title: Set the price
steps.body: Add a price. Choose one-time for a normal sale or recurring for a subscription. Prices are in NZD unless your account is set otherwise.

steps.title: Show it in the store
steps.body: Switch on **Include in Online Store**, pick a collection if you use them, then save.
steps.tip: Add variants like size or colour if customers need to choose.
